mutants.note: a[2] is undefined, so the tie-break becomes NaN, which sort treats as 0; Array.prototype.sort is stable (ES2019), so equal dates keep input order exactly as the i-index tie-break does, and equal dates are then rejected as duplicates anyway.

real_defects.issue: outlierZ was read with Number(x ?? 3.5): '' (a blank --outlier-z or form field) and 0 or a negative listed every point as unusual ('48 points stand out ... at least 0 robust standard deviations'), and a non-number gave 'by NaN robust standard deviations'. Now blank means the default and anything not a positive finite number is an error; test 'the unusual-point threshold must be a positive number'.
